lines.zh: 我贴着礁面游，背鳍竖成一根小刺。
lines.en: I skim the reef, dorsal spine raised like a small thorn.

lines.zh: 鳍一撑，我卡进身后的石缝里。
lines.en: Bracing my fins, I wedge into the gap behind me.

lines.zh: 我绕着珊瑚巡，找藏在缝里的蟹。
lines.en: I patrol the coral, hunting crabs in the gaps.

lines.zh: 尾巴一摆，我横着挪了半尺。
lines.en: One tail beat slides me sideways half a foot.

lines.zh: 我游得不快，却总在你前面。
lines.en: I swim slowly, yet always stay ahead of you.

lines.zh: 温暖浅海里，我一路低头找食。
lines.en: In the warm shallows I swim with my head down, foraging.

lines.zh: 硬鳞擦过礁石，发出细细的响声。
lines.en: My hard scales rasp the rock with a thin sound.

lines.zh: 我从海草里穿过去，草叶被顶开。
lines.en: I push through the seagrass, parting the blades.

lines.zh: 我一扭身，背鳍立起又放下。
lines.en: I twist, my dorsal spine rising and folding.

lines.zh: 它斜着游，像在量礁石的角度。
lines.en: It swims at an angle, as if measuring the rock.

lines.zh: 浪推过来，我顶着水往前走。
lines.en: A wave pushes in and I walk against the water.

lines.zh: 它绕过海绵，直奔另一处石缝。
lines.en: It rounds a sponge and heads straight for another gap.

lines.zh: 那副身板不大，游起来却很稳。
lines.en: That small frame swims with remarkable steadiness.

lines.zh: 我沿着浅海的沙脊慢慢巡游。
lines.en: I cruise slowly along the shallows' sand ridge.

lines.zh: 我在礁缝口停住，看里面有东西动。
lines.en: I stop at the crevice mouth. Something moves inside.

lines.zh: 我贴着沙面游，免得被上面看见。
lines.en: I hug the sand so nothing above spots me.

lines.zh: 那丛海草有甲壳的味道，我去看看。
lines.en: That clump of seagrass smells of shell. I'll check.

lines.zh: 有影子从上面压下来，我钻进缝里。
lines.en: A shadow bears down from above. I slip into a crack.

lines.zh: 它卡在石缝里，只露出半张脸。
lines.en: Wedged in the rock, it shows only half a face.

lines.zh: 背鳍撑着，它稳稳悬在水里。
lines.en: With its spine braced, it hangs steady in the water.

lines.zh: 它停下来，眼睛各自转着。
lines.en: It halts, each eye turning on its own.

lines.zh: 珊瑚影里，它一动不动地守着。
lines.en: In the coral shade it keeps perfectly still, on guard.

lines.zh: 它吹了吹沙，露出底下的小洞。
lines.en: It puffs at the sand and uncovers a small hole.

lines.zh: 一张一合的嘴，像在数礁石。
lines.en: Its mouth opens and closes, as if counting the rocks.

lines.zh: 我卡进珊瑚枝间，谁也拽不动。
lines.en: I lock into the coral branches where nothing can pull me free.

lines.zh: 海草床的光斑落在我硬鳞上。
lines.en: Light patches from the seagrass bed fall on my hard scales.

lines.zh: 它半闭着眼，鳍还是张着的。
lines.en: Eyes half shut, its fins remain spread.

lines.zh: 潮水来回，它的位置一点没变。
lines.en: The tide comes and goes; its position does not shift.

lines.zh: 它偶尔吐出一小股水，冲走沙。
lines.en: Now and then it spits a jet of water to clear sand.

lines.zh: 有只小蟹路过，它只是看着。
lines.en: A small crab passes and it merely watches.

lines.zh: 它把背鳍收平，像一块礁石。
lines.en: It folds its dorsal spine flat, becoming a rock.

lines.zh: 温暖的水绕着我，我懒得多动。
lines.en: Warm water curls around me and I cannot be bothered to move.

lines.zh: 我抬起一只眼，另一只还盯着礁缝。
lines.en: One eye lifts to you; the other keeps the crevice.

lines.zh: 它把身体转正，背鳍慢慢竖起。
lines.en: It squares up, dorsal spine rising slowly.

lines.zh: 它游到你面前，隔着水打量你。
lines.en: It swims before you and studies you through the water.

lines.zh: 那只眼睛转过来，像在警告。
lines.en: That eye swivels toward you, a clear warning.

lines.zh: 它不退，反而往你的方向挪了挪。
lines.en: It does not retreat; it edges toward you instead.

lines.zh: 它看你一眼，又去看你的脚边。
lines.en: It glances at you, then at the ground by your feet.

lines.zh: 它绕着你的影子转，鳍一直立着。
lines.en: It circles your shadow, fins held up.

lines.zh: 你一动，它立刻把身体卡进石缝。
lines.en: You move and it instantly wedges into the rock.

lines.zh: 它对着你张了张嘴，没有声音。
lines.en: It gapes at you, and no sound comes out.

lines.zh: 那双眼睛分开转，一只看你一只看草。
lines.en: Its eyes turn apart, one on you, one on the weeds.

lines.zh: 我立刻把身体卡进石缝，背鳍全立。
lines.en: I jam into the rock at once, every spine up.

lines.zh: 硬鳞挡住大半，可我还是疼得甩头。
lines.en: Hard scales take most of it, yet I still shake my head in pain.

lines.zh: 我不退，反而朝袭击者顶过去。
lines.en: I do not flee; I butt straight at the attacker.

lines.zh: 被咬中鳍边，它转身就咬回去。
lines.en: Bitten at the fin edge, it turns and bites back.

lines.zh: 它把身体撑大，像块没法下口的石头。
lines.en: It braces itself wide, like a stone nothing can bite.

lines.zh: 伤口在硬鳞下面，血慢慢渗出来。
lines.en: The wound lies under hard scales and blood seeps out slowly.

lines.zh: 它撞礁石泄愤，水都震了一下。
lines.en: It slams the rock in anger and the water shudders.

lines.zh: 疼过之后，它盯你的眼神更凶。
lines.en: After the pain its stare at you turns meaner.

lines.zh: 它退回缝里，只把背鳍露在外面。
lines.en: It retreats into the gap, leaving only its spine outside.

lines.zh: 六点生命撑着它，还没打算逃。
lines.en: Six points of life hold it here; it is not ready to run.

lines.zh: 蟹肉的腥味一散，我就冲了过来。
lines.en: The smell of crab meat spreads and I charge over.

lines.zh: 你手里的虾让我背鳍全立起来了。
lines.en: The shrimp in your hand raises every spine on my back.

lines.zh: 我盯着那只小蟹，眼睛都不转。
lines.en: I fix on the little crab without blinking.

lines.zh: 你把蟹腿放下，它立刻扑上来。
lines.en: You set down a crab leg and it pounces.

lines.zh: 它绕着食物游，先试了一口壳。
lines.en: It circles the food, testing the shell first.

lines.zh: 一点甲壳的碎屑就够它兴奋半天。
lines.en: A fleck of shell is enough to excite it for a while.

lines.zh: 它顶着礁石，想够到你手里的东西。
lines.en: It presses against the rock, straining for what you hold.

lines.zh: 它嗅了嗅水，笔直游向虾的味道。
lines.en: It tastes the water and swims straight for the shrimp.

lines.zh: 有壳的东西，它咬起来格外用力。
lines.en: Anything with a shell it bites with extra force.

lines.zh: 你一晃手里的蟹，它就跟了过来。
lines.en: One wave of the crab and it follows.

lines.zh: 我撞上来，硬鳞硌得你手一疼。
lines.en: I slam in, hard scales stinging your hand.

lines.zh: 背鳍一撑，我把自己卡在你脚边。
lines.en: Spine braced, I wedge myself against your foot.

lines.zh: 你挪一步，我顶着你一起挪。
lines.en: You step; I push along with you.

lines.zh: 它用吻部撞礁石，发出闷响。
lines.en: It butts the rock with a dull knock.

lines.zh: 它挤过你的腿，鳞片划了一道白痕。
lines.en: It squeezes past your leg, scales leaving a white line.

lines.zh: 撞完它不跑，反而立起背鳍。
lines.en: After the bump it stays, raising its dorsal spine.

lines.zh: 那一下力道不小，像被石头顶了。
lines.en: The shove is solid, like being pushed by a stone.

lines.zh: 它把身体横过来，堵住你的路。
lines.en: It turns broadside and blocks your way.

lines.zh: 你退开，它还跟着顶了一下。
lines.en: You step back and it butts you once more.

lines.zh: 它卡在你和礁壁之间，谁也不让。
lines.en: It wedges between you and the reef wall and gives nothing.

lines.zh: 两条扳机鱼并排，背鳍一起立起。
lines.en: Two triggerfish side by side raise their spines together.

lines.zh: 它绕着同伴转，硬鳞擦出细响。
lines.en: It circles its partner, hard scales rasping softly.

lines.zh: 沙床上，它们一前一后地打转。
lines.en: On the sand bed they turn, one behind the other.

lines.zh: 它把身体侧过去，让同伴看清鳞色。
lines.en: It turns its flank to show its partner the scale color.

lines.zh: 同伴靠近，它就收起背鳍。
lines.en: When its partner nears, it folds its spine away.

lines.zh: 它们各守一个石缝，隔着礁石相对。
lines.en: They keep separate crevices, facing each other through the rock.

lines.zh: 它用吻碰了碰对方的颊。
lines.en: It touches its partner's cheek with its snout.

lines.zh: 暖水里，它们绕成一圈又一圈。
lines.en: In the warm water they circle round and round.

lines.zh: 分开时，它把石缝让了一半。
lines.en: On parting it surrenders half the crevice.

lines.zh: 两条鱼贴着礁面，慢慢游向深处。
lines.en: Two fish hug the reef and drift toward deeper water.

lines.zh: 掉落的蟹壳，它翻过来看了看。
lines.en: A dropped crab shell gets flipped over and inspected.

lines.zh: 它叼起一块碎壳，咬两下就吐。
lines.en: It picks up a shell fragment, bites twice, and spits.

lines.zh: 不是甲壳的东西，它顶开就算了。
lines.en: Anything not shellfish it simply shoves aside.

lines.zh: 你丢下的物品沉底，它绕了一圈。
lines.en: Your dropped item sinks and it circles once.

lines.zh: 它把碎石当成蟹，咬了个空。
lines.en: It mistakes a pebble for a crab and bites nothing.

lines.zh: 捡到的东西太大，它含不住。
lines.en: The thing it picked up is too big to hold.

lines.zh: 它把贝壳拖到石缝口，慢慢研究。
lines.en: It drags the shell to its crevice and studies it.

lines.zh: 一口咬碎，壳渣散了一地。
lines.en: One bite crushes it and shell bits scatter.

lines.zh: 它对掉落物只挑有壳的。
lines.en: Among dropped things it takes only the shelled ones.

lines.zh: 捡完它退回石缝，像在藏东西。
lines.en: After picking it retreats to its crevice, as if stashing.

lines.zh: 一只蟹从沙里探出头，被我盯上。
lines.en: A crab pokes from the sand and I lock on.

lines.zh: 我把眼睛对准石缝里的一点动静。
lines.en: I aim an eye at a stirring in the crevice.

lines.zh: 目标很小，壳却很硬。
lines.en: The target is small, its shell very hard.

lines.zh: 我伏低身体，鳍收得紧紧的。
lines.en: I flatten low, fins pulled tight.

lines.zh: 我选中了那只落单的虾。
lines.en: I pick the lone shrimp.

lines.zh: 一只寄居蟹爬过，它立刻记住了位置。
lines.en: A hermit crab crawls by and it marks the spot.

lines.zh: 它绕着礁石找角度，等蟹出来。
lines.en: It circles the rock for an angle, waiting the crab out.

lines.zh: 目标一露头，它的眼睛就定住了。
lines.en: The moment the target shows, its eye freezes on it.

lines.zh: 它不追快的，只挑壳薄的。
lines.en: It ignores the quick ones and picks the thin-shelled.

lines.zh: 我已经算好，一口就能咬穿。
lines.en: I have already judged that one bite will crack it.

lines.zh: 它贴着沙底逼近，鳍几乎不动。
lines.en: It creeps along the sand, fins almost still.

lines.zh: 蟹往左边跑，它就绕到左边等。
lines.en: The crab runs left; it circles to wait on the left.

lines.zh: 它吹开沙子，把猎物逼出来。
lines.en: It blows the sand away to flush the prey out.

lines.zh: 距离一近，它的背鳍竖得笔直。
lines.en: As it closes in, its dorsal spine stands straight up.

lines.zh: 它用嘴顶住石缝，堵死退路。
lines.en: It jams its mouth into the gap, sealing the escape.

lines.zh: 猎物钻进壳里，它就在外面守着。
lines.en: The prey hides in its shell and it keeps watch outside.

lines.zh: 它一次次冲撞石缝，逼蟹现身。
lines.en: It charges the crevice again and again to force the crab out.

lines.zh: 它绕到猎物背后，慢慢压近。
lines.en: It gets behind the prey and presses closer.

lines.zh: 追到珊瑚底下，它也不肯松口。
lines.en: Even under the coral it will not let go.

lines.zh: 它把猎物翻过来，找没有壳的地方。
lines.en: It flips the prey over, hunting the unarmored side.

lines.zh: 一口咬碎蟹壳，声音清脆。
lines.en: One bite cracks the crab shell with a crisp sound.

lines.zh: 它用硬鳞撞过去，把蟹顶翻。
lines.en: It rams with its hard scales and flips the crab over.

lines.zh: 那口牙专为撬壳而生。
lines.en: Those teeth were made for prying shells apart.

lines.zh: 它咬住蟹腿，猛地一拧。
lines.en: It bites a crab leg and twists hard.

lines.zh: 它咬你的手指，像在试壳的硬度。
lines.en: It bites your finger as if testing a shell's hardness.

lines.zh: 背鳍一撑，它借力弹出去撞。
lines.en: Bracing its spine, it springs forward to strike.

lines.zh: 一口不够，它又补了第二口。
lines.en: One bite is not enough; it adds a second.

lines.zh: 它把猎物按在沙上，慢慢拆开。
lines.en: It pins the prey to the sand and takes it apart.

lines.zh: 那一下咬得很深，疼得人缩手。
lines.en: The bite goes deep and makes you pull your hand back.

lines.zh: 攻击完，它嘴里还叼着壳渣。
lines.en: After the attack, shell bits still hang from its mouth.

lines.zh: 珊瑚礁的枝杈间，它慢慢现出身形。
lines.en: Among the coral branches it slowly takes shape.

lines.zh: 海草床的沙上，多了一个小影子。
lines.en: A small shadow appears on the seagrass bed's sand.

lines.zh: 温暖浅海里，它一出现就竖起背鳍。
lines.en: In the warm shallows it appears with its spine already raised.

lines.zh: 每次只有一条，独自占着一块礁。
lines.en: Only one arrives, holding a patch of reef alone.

lines.zh: 刷怪蛋一碎，它先卡进最近的石缝。
lines.en: The egg breaks and it wedges into the nearest crevice first.

lines.zh: 它从礁影里游出，眼睛已经转个不停。
lines.en: It swims from the reef shadow, eyes already roving.

lines.zh: 浅海的暖水里，它先试了一口沙。
lines.en: In the shallows' warm water it tests a mouthful of sand.

lines.zh: 它出现的地方，小蟹都往缝里钻。
lines.en: Where it appears, the small crabs dive into cracks.

lines.zh: 一块礁石上，它慢慢把鳍撑开。
lines.en: On a patch of rock it slowly spreads its fins.

lines.zh: 珊瑚的白影里，它守着自己的角落。
lines.en: In the white coral shade it guards its own corner.

lines.zh: 火一烤，我的硬鳞发烫，拼命往深处钻。
lines.en: The fire heats my hard scales and I burrow deeper.

lines.zh: 落在礁石上，我扑腾着找最近的水。
lines.en: Dropped on the rocks, I flop toward the nearest water.

lines.zh: 它张嘴吸水，鳃却像被什么堵住了。
lines.en: It gulps water, yet its gills seem blocked.

lines.zh: 冲击把我掀出石缝，硬鳞掉了一片。
lines.en: The blast tears me from the crevice and a scale flies off.

lines.zh: 箭撞在硬鳞上弹开，我还是被震歪了。
lines.en: The arrow glances off my scales but still knocks me askew.

lines.zh: 光一罩，它的鳍立也不是收也不是。
lines.en: Under the light its fins neither rise nor fold properly.

lines.zh: 饿得久了，它连空壳都咬。
lines.en: Starved long enough, it bites even empty shells.

lines.zh: 雷打在水面，它整条鱼僵了一瞬。
lines.en: Lightning hits the surface and it stiffens for an instant.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有礁石，它无处可卡。
lines.en: There is no rock in the void, nowhere to wedge itself.
